einzeiler: Exploring global conflicts, history's patterns, and their ties to the United States.
kurzfassung: Al Jazeera reports on ongoing developments in the occupied West Bank and Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon. The podcast then introduces Deja Vu, a new series exploring how historical patterns connect to the modern world and American history. Host Mohamed Hassan invites listeners to engage with historians and public thinkers to better understand the present through the past.
stichpunkte: Nida Ibrahim reports on Palestinian accountability, rights, and settler attacks in Turmushaya.
Locals request the reopening of a road closed by the Israeli army near Shiloh settlement outposts.
Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon kill three people and injure 23 others.
The Israeli military states the strikes were a response to a Hezbollah drone.
Israel and Lebanon previously agreed to a ceasefire in June, which Israel has repeatedly violated.
Mohamed Hassan presents Deja Vu, connecting turbulent history to the modern world and the United States.

clips.text: The host reflects on the recurring nature of historical events and compares understanding the past to reading a map.
